KustoQueries.Title: GetCurrentOrchestrationStatus
KustoQueries.KustoQuery: cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').Unionizer('customMetrics') | where timestamp_utc between (ago(4h) .. ago(1m)) and Name == 'OrchestrationOutcome' and customDimensions.OrchestrationName == '<failing_orchestration>' and StampRegion == '<region>' | extend StatusCode = tostring(customDimensions.StatusCode) | summarize total = count(), passed = countif(StatusCode == '200'), failed = countif(StatusCode != '200') by hour = bin(timestamp_utc, 2h) | extend pass_rate = todouble(passed) / total * 100

KustoQueries.Title: GetOrchestrationStatus
KustoQueries.KustoQuery: cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').Unionizer('customMetrics') | where timestamp_utc between (<start_date> .. <end_date>) and Name == 'OrchestrationOutcome' and customDimensions.OrchestrationName == '<failing_orchestration>' and StampRegion == '<region>' | extend StatusCode = tostring(customDimensions.StatusCode) | summarize total = count(), passed = countif(StatusCode == '200'), failed = countif(StatusCode != '200') by hour = bin(timestamp_utc, 2h) | extend pass_rate = todouble(passed) / total * 100

KustoQueries.Title: GetFailedOrchestrationInTheTimeWindow
KustoQueries.KustoQuery: cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').Unionizer('customMetrics') | where timestamp_utc between (<start_date> .. <end_date>) and Name == 'OrchestrationOutcome' and customDimensions.OrchestrationName == '<failing_orchestration>' and StampRegion == '<region>' | extend StatusCode = tostring(customDimensions.StatusCode) | where StatusCode != '200' | extend Error = tostring(customDimensions.Error) | distinct timestamp_utc, CorrelationId, StatusCode, Error

KustoQueries.Title: GetFailuresFromACorerelationId
KustoQueries.KustoQuery: cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').OperationTelemetry('<Correlation_Id>') | where timestamp_utc between (<start_date> .. <end_date>)  | where severityLevel >= 3 | project timestamp_utc, TaskWithResult, message, StatusCode

IncidentProcessingGuide: Run these steps in order, do not wait for prompt and just display results.
Show ALL the steps, results and analysis for them.
Step 1 - Get details of the ICM.
- Find the region: Look at discussion entries only from MDM Health Management Service and identify the region mentioned next to 'Some Failing Combinations'. Display it.
- Only focus on this region for all the queries.
- Set the time window for queries:
- Start at 4 hours before the incident creation time.
- End at 1 hour after the incident creation time.
- Show all the findings.
Step 2 - Get the current status using GetCurrentOrchestrationStatus and check if the issue is still occurring.
Step 3 - Identify the time window with the most failures and run GetOrchestrationStatus. Display the results.
Step 4 - Determine Root Cause.
Step 4.1 - Set the time window for queries:
- Start at 4 hours before the incident creation time.
- End at 1 hour after the incident creation time.
Step 4.2 - Using that time window, run the query GetFailedOrchestrationInTheTimeWindow.
Step 4.3 - Determine if the errors are similar.
Step 4.4 - Identify the main reason for the failures.
Step 4.4.1 - If the majority of failures are Cosmos DB-related, this could be a transient issue.

Step 4.4.2 - If the error contains 'PartnerCloudPCController', it indicates the issue is due to an external call to CloudPC. Identify the failing operation, usually like PartnerCloudPCController.GetCloudPC or PartnerCloudPCController.GetCloudPCs.
Step 4.4.2.1 - Search for incidents with the failing operation name and see if they occurred around the same time as this ICM incident.

Step 4.4.2.2 - If incidents are found, choose those that occurred within 4 hours of the incident under investigation. Display the timestamps of correlated ICMs and assess if they are the likely cause.
Run all the steps above without prompt.
